final_answer.policy_summary: New transactions falling in or before a Pending Close period are not staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting until the period is closed or reopened. Transactions entered before Pending Close continue processing, including error-state transactions. Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments continue processing after Pending Close.
